classification.difficultyReason: Read both intersections of the sine and cosine curves within the stated domain.

content.prompt: Using the graphs of $y=\sin x$ and $y=\cos x$ shown below, for what angles are the values of $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ equal in the domain $0^\circ\leq x<360^\circ$?

spec.description: Two black, directly labelled curves on one rectangular grid, with degree labels at 90°, 180°, 270° and 360° and ordinate labels 1, 0 and −1.
spec.mathematics: Plot y=sin x and y=cos x for 0°≤x≤360° using degree arguments. Sine has extrema at 90° and 270°; cosine has extrema at 0°, 180° and 360°. The curves intersect at 45° and 225°.
spec.answerVisibility: Both complete curves are permanent supplied givens. No T/F responses, comparison guides or intersection labels appear in the student figure.

answer.worked: The curves intersect at $x=45^\circ$ and $x=225^\circ$. These are the two angles in $0^\circ\leq x<360^\circ$ where $\sin x=\cos x$.
